items.title: MONITOR
items.placementTarget: Back of each player reference card
items.text:
MONITOR
At a satellite tower, draw and discard 4 Player cards in any order. Then, scratch off one box on the Frequency Scanner.

rules: Use it at a satellite tower.
Draw and discard 4 Player cards in any order.
Then scratch off one box on the Frequency Scanner.
mechanics.effect: Action at a satellite tower: draw and discard 4 Player cards in any order, then scratch one Frequency Scanner box. The icon is a yellow scanner dial.

items.title: Reference card placement
items.text: Place this sticker on the back of each player reference card.

mechanics.effect: Place the Monitor sticker on the back of each player reference card.
